`--input_layer`

Which layer to use. If no value is provided, the counts are assumed to be in the `.X` slot. Otherwise, count data is expected to be in `.layers[input_layer]`.

`string`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--input_obs_batch`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Key in obs field of input adata for batch information. If no value is provided, batch label is assumed to be unknown.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}

:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Subset the input object with this column.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--input_obs_label`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Key in obs field of input adata for label information. This is only used for training scANVI. Unlabelled cells should be set to `"unknown_celltype_label"`.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--unknown_celltype_label`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
If `input_obs_label` is specified, cells with this value will be treated as unknown and will be predicted by the model.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"unknown"`

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/annotate/popv/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/annotate/popv);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/annotate/popv/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
